title: 毎日王冠の後に・切れねえ啖呵

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One manages to win the Mainichi Okan. However, the sheer intensity emanating from Oguri Cap makes her quake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, she overhears the fans talking and realizes her performance wasn't enough to prove the might of the Oi racers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal race, the autumn Tenno Sho, is right around the corner, but Inari One is becoming increasingly anxious that she might not make it as Umamusume of the Year.
